# Dangbu Unlimited Samgyupsal &amp; Buffet

> Korean BBQ restaurant in Quezon City, Philippines. Unlimited samgyupsal and
> BBQ buffet with four packages from ₱299 to ₱499 per head, two branches, and
> online table reservations.

Dangbu is a family-friendly all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ house. The menu includes
unlimited pork, beef, enoki, chicken, main dishes, side dishes, rice, sauces
and dessert. Prices are per head, dine-in.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dangbu.vercel.app/): Marketing site, packages, branches, hours, and reservation form.
- [Standard Set ₱299](https://dangbu.vercel.app/menu/299): Full menu poster for the ₱299 package.
- [All Time Favorite ₱399](https://dangbu.vercel.app/menu/399): Full menu poster for the ₱399 package.
- [Signature Feast ₱459](https://dangbu.vercel.app/menu/459): Full menu poster for the ₱459 package.
- [Best Seller ₱499](https://dangbu.vercel.app/menu/499): Full menu poster for the ₱499 package.
- [Reservation status](https://dangbu.vercel.app/reservation): Look up a booking with a reservation reference.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dangbu.vercel.app/privacy): How personal data is handled.
- [Terms](https://dangbu.vercel.app/terms): Terms of service.

## Branches

- Main Branch: West Fairview, Quezon City — daily 11:00–22:00 — 0945 673 2698
- Novaliches Branch: Lot 4, Blk 3 Buenamar St., Novaliches Proper, Quezon City — daily 11:00–22:00 — (02) 7001-0685

## Optional

- Reservations can also be made by phone; walk-ins are welcome but reservations are seated first.
- Leftovers are charged separately; menu items may change based on availability.
